scope: Offline inspection of saved 0.16.9 Y Harness / DeepSeek V4.1 Flash events. All original costs remain counted. Annotated step costs are past usage, not a forecast or savings subtraction.

issues.evidence: The agent searched branches/tags, unrelated modules, parent workspace and instruction folders while inferring hidden evaluation intent.
issues.fix: Use supplied instructions, known repo instruction files and actual caller/dependency evidence. Do not seek evaluation metadata to infer requirements.

issues.evidence: The full suite ran before caller cases were added, then ran again as the actual characterization baseline. Step 4 also includes a useful reference search; it is not classified as wholly removable.
issues.fix: Select and add only missing cases before the single passing baseline.

issues.issue: cosmetic edit and rerun after passing checks
issues.evidence: After tests and diff review, the agent changed already-correct retry call sites from positional arguments to keywords and reran the full suite.
issues.fix: Finish after behavior/scope review and required checks; exclude unrequested polish.

issues.evidence: After caller tests passed, a new script reimplemented old helper logic for a thirty-input comparison. Additional input coverage was not independently graded, so this entire check is not credited as avoidable.
issues.fix: Choose needed differential cases before editing and preserve that baseline; keep genuinely uncovered cases.

issues.issue: mixed functional correction and doc polish
issues.evidence: A late edit combined preserving one string conversion with a docstring wording change. The conversion difference is concrete and must not be removed as mere polish.
issues.fix: Retain actual behavior corrections; keep cosmetic changes outside the completed refactor.

limits: The revised prompts are not behaviorally re-evaluated. Metadata hunts, repeated hypothesis generation and late cosmetic work are observed; their future removal and total billed-cost effect remain unverified.
